name: pothos
description: Your PothOS continuity and explicitly shared work through JoshOps AI.

interface.longDescription: JoshOps AI connects your own PothOS account and ArcheAgent continuity. Keep selected Markdown notes, recover earlier saves, and join explicitly offered shared projects. In the JoshOps pilot, send selected messages or print requests and read replies. Personal memory stays separate from shared work. A received print request does not start a printer. Requires your own invited PothOS account and the capabilities available to that account. PothOS software is free for personal, nonprofit and business use. An invitation controls hosted access; it is not a payment requirement. AI provider subscriptions remain separate. Native device enrollment and public app-store releases are separate availability checks.
defaultPrompt: Continue the notes in my private PothOS workspace.
Show the latest replies in my shared JoshOps pilot.

review.commerce_description: Connects an existing invited PothOS account. PothOS software is free for personal, nonprofit and business use. The plugin does not sell products, create subscriptions, offer upgrades or process payments. AI provider subscriptions, usage, hosting and hardware remain separate. Existing billing records from the retired offer are handled in the PothOS application.

publication.release_notes: Aligns the displayed application name with JoshOps AI and corrects its Terms link. Existing PothOS identifier, OAuth endpoint, permissions, account isolation and supported operations are preserved. This package is staged for review; it is not a directory approval.
